text: Bounded parent decision support is acceptable only if it avoids broad coverage and real-time claims.
Structured packaging is the mechanism that converts parent triage into reviewable MCP value.
Missing endpoint and PlayMCP evidence justify separating local-ready from public-ready.
Cache-first trust still requires retrieved_at, cache age, and source-specific proof boundaries.
Deployment cannot proceed automatically if the selected host path would require image-baked secrets.
PlayMCP metadata must not become marketing copy that implies all-event coverage.
Expansion is allowed only through evidence-tier promotion, not through copy changes.
The missing Operations evidence can be closed by the deployment evidence packet.
The final readiness decision derives from local-ready plus blocked public/PlayMCP evidence.
Disciplined confidence requires visible source and cache truth, not stronger wording.
PlayMCP discovery and starter smoke are the next observable acceptance tests.
Architecture mapping should not delay deployment unless it reduces deployment risk.
